name: Menuvi – Menu Powerhouse | Edit and Access Menu FAST
author: surviving404

sections.description:
Menuvi gives you complete control over your WordPress dashboard menu. You can easily:
* Hide menu items based on user roles
* Rename any menu or submenu item
* Reorder menu items via a simple drag-and-drop interface
* Create custom keyboard shortcuts for your most used admin pages

Keep your dashboard clean and tailored for your clients or different user roles.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/menuvi directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings -> Menuvi to configure your admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this modify core WordPress files?

No, all changes are made dynamically without altering any core files.
